label: Confirmed Incursion Incidents
source: Aggregated NATO member-state defence ministry reports, Mar 23 – Sep 18, 2026
contestNote: Counting methodology varies by government; per AP reporting Sep 17 citing Romania's Ministry of National Defence, Romania's own dashboard now counts 27 confirmed drone incursions in 2026 (up from 25 on Aug 25, and nearly triple the 9 in all of 2025), 37 drones/fragments found on Romanian territory (vs 16 in 2025), 73 Russian strikes near the border (vs 28 in 2025), and 56 aircraft scrambles (vs 21 in 2025) — not all scrambles confirm an actual incursion. Romania's Foreign Ministry separately cited 44 unauthorized drone incursions 'since the start of the war' as of Sep 2, a cumulative-since-2022 figure not directly comparable to the 2026-only tally. Poland's repeated Il-20 reconnaissance-flight intercepts and its Sep 14 Rusinowo drone recovery are excluded from this count since officials confirmed no airspace violation occurred.
